reviews.title: Reliable
reviews.comment: I've been using this power supply for about a week, and so far no issues. The fan is basically silent and you wont be hearing this at all. It is a non modular PSU though so you're gonna want a space for cable management in your pc or it'll be a hassle. Overall, for its price, its perfect.
